text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for tryouts to begin. It
looks like Смарт Фалкон will be

participating in the 1,600-meter turf race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Wait, no. I have to be positive and smile brightly—like a true Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But still... What if I fail aga—no! I can't let
myself think like that! I've
been training
super hard! I'm sure I'll be fine this time!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She still looks unsure of herself as she
starts out the gate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Although she runs as fast as she can, the
trainers watching her remain
unimpressed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's here again, huh? I get that
she's trying her best, but
there's something
missing from her running...
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Just like the other trainer says, Smart
Falcon seems to be struggling
on the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Out of the race's twelve contestants, Smart
Falcon finishes in tenth
place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although her placement is less than ideal,
the power in her running
form drew my
attention. It's not that she's missing
something from her
running, but rather...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! Aaah, I probably
looked super lame back there...
Sorry
about that.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But hey, I heard that people like cheering
on the underdog! You
know, since it's nice
to see them grow!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm beginning to suspect that it isn't a
matter of growth, but
compatibility. Given
her style of running, a dirt course might
suit her
better...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I'm no good, huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, it wasn't just today. I
messed up all my other
tryouts too. I don't
have anything to show for myself, so
nobody wants
to scout me...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I know I don't have a lot going for me, but
still... I want to become the
best Umadol
ever!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's my dream to win races and perform
winning concerts on the
biggest stages!
But I can't do that on my own...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's why... I need you! I need your help
to reach my goal!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Please, help me! Even a single training
session would mean the world
to me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Her words are earnest, and I can see that
she wants nothing more than
to achieve
her dreams. Naturally, as a trainer, I want
to lend her a
hand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?! Like, for real?! Phew... I'm so glad I asked you!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to start training with you! Bring
it on! Whatever it is, I'll do
it. No holding
back, okay?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
For now, I decide to set aside the question
of whether or not I'll
become Smart
Falcon's trainer and focus on preparing her
for the next
round of tryouts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Nrgh! Nnnngh! Hrnng! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Wow, look at her doing those leg curls! Those weights look super heavy! Her smile's kinda creeping me out though...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm ready to run! ☆ Hiyayayayaaah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I don't see any issues with her weight
lifting or incline running. If
anything, she
seems stronger than the average runner.
Yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... H-how's my time?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Oof... I'm not getting any better...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Whenever she races on a turf course, her
results are always lackluster.
My hunch
seems to be right that it's a compatibility
issue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! Suzuka! Over here!
text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me, but I have to train for
tomorrow's race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the cheers of excited
Umamusume, Сайленс Судзука
looks
somewhat troubled. Already having made
her debut, she's been
putting on an
impressive display across many races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys! ☆ I get that you all are
huge fans of hers, but you
gotta give her
some space!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's getting ready to train so she can
shine during her next race!
True fans
should be patient and wait to watch her
then, don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She's right...
Sorry for bothering you!
text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Falcon... I wasn't sure what to
do there...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Just call me Falco! ☆ If you're ever in that
kinda situation again, just
make yourself
clear! They'll listen, I promise! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure you know that better than I
do...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you've got practice, right? Good
luck! ☆ I'll be cheering for
you too! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So... could you explain why we're here at
the dirt course?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: I just want to time your running here as well.

text_block_list.text:
I believe a course that requires power—in
other words, a dirt
course—might better
suit Смарт Фалкон. I tell her how I'd like to

confirm my suspicions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... Got it! But... don't expect too
much from me, okay?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Hiyayayayaya!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I was right. Her time on the dirt course is leaps and bounds better. She's met—no, exceeded my expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: That was your best time yet!

text_block_list.text:
Everything's falling into place. I now know
for certain that running on
a dirt course,
which requires more strength than agility,
brings out her
true potential.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But with that, a new question arises. Why
haven't her teachers picked
up on
something as elementary as this and told
her about it?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You should be running in dirt races.

text_block_list.text: Hrk... I thought you'd say that.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But... no! I can't! I can't run on dirt!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I have to win on turf or this is all pointless!
I don't have any other
choice!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
A-anyway, I have dance practice now, so
let's call it here! Thank you
for today!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As I watch Смарт Фалкон dash across the
dirt at an incredible speed, I
begin to
wonder why she insists on running in turf
races. Her reasoning
could be a hint to
helping her grow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
